# Parry

> Parry is the commercial AI intelligence, execution and autonomous platform for enterprise procurement. It connects in a few clicks to the ERP, P2P, contract and communication systems an enterprise already runs, builds one source of truth per vendor on a proprietary vertical procurement graph, and negotiates, renews and validates spend within the customer's rules.

Parry is based in New York. Book a demo or a Spend MRI at https://www.parry-io.com/.

## Key facts
- Results: up to 35% less manual workload; up to 18% hard-dollar spend reduction.
- Four pillars: AI supplier management; full-cycle saving plans; real-time negotiation; procure-to-pay validation.
- The learning loop: Understand (commercial graph, supplier history, policy, market intelligence) → Decide (autonomous and hybrid reasoning within your rules) → Execute (negotiate, renew, alert, buy) → Validate (invoice matching, autonomous execution), learning on every lap.
- Governance: you set the guardrails; Parry negotiates, contracts, renews and transacts within them.
- Coverage: IT, SaaS, professional services, sales and marketing, R&D, maintenance and other OpEx.
- Pricing: based on savings on spend ("we win when you save"); modular, pay only for the modules you choose.
- Spend MRI: a 30-minute review of a company's own spend data mapping leaks, levers and renewals at risk.
